notes: Dockerfile.final created following the workspace contract: repo_setup.sh runs first to clone the semantic-kernel repository, then setup_runtime.sh creates the Python venv with poetry. Evaluation assets (eval.sh, tests/) are intentionally NOT baked into the image as they are runtime-mounted verifier assets. Final WORKDIR is /workspace. Build context contains all required files (setup_runtime.sh, repo_setup.sh) in /artifacts/environment/.
